plan.notes: Source: University of North Florida official Osprey Map (term-by-term sample schedule) for Computing & Information Sciences, https://www.unf.edu/catalog/ospreymaps/2025-2026/Computing-Info-Sciences-Data-Science.html, retrieved 2026-10-09. UNF describes the Osprey Map as a sample schedule (not a contract) to be used with an academic advisor; mile-marker courses should be completed before/by the end of that term. CATALOG YEAR: the map is published under UNF's 2024-2025 Osprey Maps path and the page states 'Effective Term: Fall 2024'; the byte-identical page is also served at the 2025-2026 path (UNF has not published newer maps) — recorded as catalog_year 2024-2025. Terms transcribed as Year N Fall/Spring (UNF labels them Terms 1-8; sequence assumes fall start). Summer advisory tables are suggestions only (catch-up/get-ahead options) and are not sequenced. Credit ranges printed on some rows resolved at the catalog minimum per collection standard; UNF declares Total Program Hours: 120 — sequence sums to 116 at minimum elective credits, and free-elective rows carry UNF's note 'If needed for 120 total hours'. Osprey Maps do not publish per-course enrollment prerequisites; mile markers below are progression milestones (minimum grade C). Mile markers: Term 1: Attempted Hours 0-15: MAC2311 (GM) Calculus I Minimum Grade C | Term 2: Attempted Hours 16-30: COP2220 Programming I Minimum Grade C | Summer 1: MAC2312 (GM) Calculus II Minimum Grade C | Term 3: Attempted Hours 31-45: COT3100 Comp Structures OR MAD3107 Discrete Math | Term 4: Attempted Hours 46-60: COP3503 Programming II Minimum Grade C | Term 5: Attempted Hours 61-75: COP3530 Data Structures Minimum Grade C General Education Requirements | Term 6: Attempted Hours 76-90: COP3703 Introduction to Databases Minimum Grade C Civic Literacy Requirement | Term 7: Attempted Hours 91-105: CAP4770 Data Mining Minimum Grade C. CATALOG ARITHMETIC ERROR (Term 7): UNF prints "Total Hours: 15" but the listed rows sum to 14 (3+3+3+3+2); transcribed at the row sum of 14 with Term 7 declared accordingly.
